items.text: added: the colophon now has an AI:RATIO block, laid out as in Current. It is blank for now (not yet scored); the 100% non-AI-in-use line, the foundations note and the disclosure are filled in.

changed: on a large desktop screen (1500 px wide and up) the tempo bar is as wide as the pop-up panels, centred, with scenes and undo on its left and record, share and the rest on its right. On a very wide screen (a 4K or 5K monitor) the panels and the tempo bar grow together, up to 1400 px, so the slider is longer to drag. Laptops keep the size they have.

changed: the four ring ways (Radar clockwise, Radar anticlockwise, Ring widening, Ring closing) no longer turn the grid into a circle. The grid stays square; the line sweeps it in a circle (radar, by slice of the turn, with the ring a cell sits in giving its pitch) or outwards and inwards through the square rings. Because every way now plays the same grid, Halo, painting and editing work the same under all of them, and a second or third line can use any way at once. Scenes you saved while a ring way was on keep their marks on the square grid, not on the old circle.
changed: the hand button no longer has a hidden pop-out menu, because hand, hold and pencil are all on the rail already.
changed: in edit mode the pencil and its five tools (column, row, copy, cut, paste) are one block, and the yellow edge runs down all of it instead of capping the pencil and leaving a gap.
changed: touching the pencil now morphs the rail: the icons that go slide down and fade, the new ones slide up into place, and it runs in reverse when you go back to the hand.

changed: every pane of the heads-up display now has a clear title across the top, with its icon and its place in the strip (for example "Mixer, 1 / 8"), the way Current names its panels, so you always know where you are.
changed: tapping Colour or Shape while Halo is on now turns Halo off and picks that one in the same tap, so there is no need to switch Halo off first.

changed: Stay awake is now a button in the bottom bar, next to Full screen, instead of a symbol floating top right that could sit on top of the hand button. It is lit while the screen is being kept awake.

changed: on a tablet or desktop the heads-up display is now a normal-size panel docked above the tempo bar, with the stage still in view and playable above it, and the pin keeps it up. On a phone it still fills the stage. The bottom bar takes a reasonable width, centred, on one line.
